section_summary.extract_value: This section details the Loneliness scale used in the study, which is the Three-Item Loneliness Scale developed by Hughes et al. (2004) from the revised UCLA Loneliness Scale. It describes the 3-point response categories, scoring method, and notes that the three items were derived from an Italian version of the scale. The scale demonstrated good internal consistency with an alpha of .844.
